title: Beetle God Ritual
description: A large anthropomorphic beetle deity with multiple crowns and ornate bracelets stands atop a mound of dark organic matter, arms raised in a mystical gesture as golden particles float around its hands. Below, four robed human figures kneel in a circle around the mound, surrounded by lit candles connected by glowing lines on the ground, set against a dark, smoky background with floating orbs.
